title: assign_devid silently disables all hardware hash via g_tls_safe_mode
description: wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid / assign_devid_ssl set g_tls_safe_mode=1, which routes ALL WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH ops in the process to CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (software). This is a global side-effect invisible from the function name and signature. User scenario: an application that wants hardware SHA for bulk file-integrity AND hardware AES+HMAC for TLS calls assign_devid(ctx) to set up TLS, and then finds their bulk SHA256 calls no longer use hardware. The NOTE at port.c:1513-1519 documents this but the documentation only appears in the implementation, not in the header declaration. Any user who reads only crypto2dev_port.h will be surprised.
